name: Unsplash
label: Unsplash Photos API
description: Official Unsplash API v1. Client-ID header. search_photos, photo_get, random, download_trigger (/photos/{id}/download), user_get. Hotlink urls; attribution required. No scrape.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-invoke fields for Unsplash. Do not put secrets here. Example: {"operation":"search_photos"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: search_photos | photo_get | random | download_trigger | user_get. Example: 'search_photos'.

schema.label: query
schema.description: Search text. Required on search_photos; optional on random. Example: office.

schema.label: orientation
schema.description: EXACT: landscape | portrait | squarish. search_photos / random.

schema.label: color
schema.description: search_photos color filter. EXACT: black_and_white | black | white | yellow | orange | red | purple | magenta | green | teal | blue. https://unsplash.com/documentation#search-photos

schema.label: order_by
schema.description: search_photos sort. EXACT: relevant | latest. Default relevant.

ports.name: output
ports.description: OfficialApiNode result: {status,http_status,data} on 2xx. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT: 'ok'. Absent on failure. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: HTTP status from the provider. Example: 200.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). OfficialApiNode places the provider payload here. Example: provider object.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: search_photos | photo_get | random | download_trigger | user_get. Example: 'search_photos'.

configurationParameters.label: Access Key
configurationParameters.description: Unsplash Access Key. Header Authorization: Client-ID. Demo 50 req/h; production 1000 req/h after approval. https://unsplash.com/documentation/

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 25. <=0 falls back to 25. Example: 25.
